vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: icp-filing
Version: 2.3.1

The ICP Filing Guide skill is a purely informational tool designed to assist users with the Chinese website registration process. The core logic in `scripts/icp.sh` consists of a Python script that prints static checklists, procedural steps, and generates simple HTML footer snippets. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, network activity, or unauthorized system access.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only ICP filing helper whose included script and docs match the stated purpose and do not request credentials or perform network/exfiltration actions.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (ICP filing guide) align with the provided commands and the included scripts: checklist, flow, query, province, footer. No unrelated binaries, services, or credentials are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md and the bundled scripts stay within the ICP filing domain. Minor inconsistency: SKILL.md mentions an ICP_FILING_DIR env var to change a data directory, but the provided scripts do not actually read or use that variable — a harmless documentation mismatch but worth noting.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec (instruction-only) and the repository only contains a small shell script that runs an embedded Python snippet. Nothing is downloaded or extracted from external URLs during install.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no credentials or sensitive environment variables. The only env var mentioned (ICP_FILING_DIR) is optional/documentary and not used by the script.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not attempt to modify other skills or system-wide agent settings. It runs locally and does not request elevated/system persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: The skill appears coherent and limited in scope: it prints ICP filing guidance and helper outputs locally. Before running scripts from any unknown source, review the file (scripts/icp.sh) yourself and run it in a restricted environment if you prefer. Note the minor doc mismatch: SKILL.md mentions ICP_FILING_DIR but the script does not use it. There are no network calls or credential requests in the code, but if you install/rename the script to a system PATH name (e.g., icp-filing), ensure you trust the publisher (BytesAgain link in the files) or host it from a trusted location.
